_说明: viewer3d.html?model=well7 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。一个竖向场景：上面是中层 C 区的层间检查点（z≈64），下面是下层地基区 7 号井井底黑市（z=0），竖井相连；中层底面、周边楼群、支撑柱（bg_*）只在成图里。

title.zh: 层间检查点与 7 号井

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

name.zh: 中层 · C 区检查点

desc.zh: 中层 C 区甲板：井口所在的钢结构平台，南沿可见桁架、检修管和工作灯。
desc.en: Mid-tier Zone C deck: the steel platform around the shaft mouth, with trusses, service pipes and work lights along its south edge.

desc.zh: 层间检查点：执法局的临时管控站——集装箱改的岗亭、水马隔离墩、拖车灯塔。跨层要持执政厅签发的通行许可。
desc.en: Inter-tier Checkpoint: an Enforcement Bureau temporary control post: a converted shipping-container booth, jersey barriers and trailer light towers. Crossing tiers needs a permit from the Executive Office.

desc.zh: 通道闸口：道闸、三辊闸、安检门，每条通道一台查验身份芯片与随身铭牌的读卡柱。
desc.en: Lane gates: barrier arms, turnstiles and scanner arches, each lane with a reader for identity chips and carried tags.

desc.zh: 货物征税查验点：开箱查验、过磅、登记清单；下层货物进入中层缴 5% 入境税。
desc.en: Goods-tax inspection point: crates are opened, weighed and logged; lower-tier goods entering the mid tier pay a 5% entry tax.

desc.zh: 7 号井：从中层直通地面的检修竖井，内有折返楼梯，井壁潮湿滴水。
desc.en: Well 7: a service shaft running from the mid tier down to the ground, with a switchback stair inside and damp, dripping walls.

desc.zh: 井内升降梯：货客两用，连接检查点与井底。
desc.en: Shaft lift: freight and passengers between the checkpoint and the shaft base.

desc.zh: 井底黑市：在井口周围自发形成的摊位；这里只收灰票（匿名芯片卡），天城只有下层黑市还用实体货币。
desc.en: Well 7 black market: stalls that grew up around the shaft base. Only grey scrip (anonymous chip cards) is accepted; in Tiancheng only the lower-tier black market still uses physical money.

desc.zh: 老 K 杂货：货架、柜台和一个只认灰票的读卡口。
desc.en: Old K's grocery: shelves, a counter and a card slot that takes only grey scrip.

desc.zh: 黑市终端角：一台旧终端，屏幕上只有跳动的绿线，缆线成束。
desc.en: Black-market terminal nook: an old terminal whose screen shows only flickering green lines, fed by a bundle of cables.

desc.zh: 层层叠起的铁皮棚屋和头顶管线把井底市场围得很逼仄。
desc.en: Stacked tin shacks and overhead pipes hem the market into a cramped pocket.

desc.zh: 来路各异的货箱和日用品。
desc.en: Crates and everyday goods of mixed origin.
